basis: System first, bath second; |0> ground |1> excited. H_system=(h*f)*diag(0,1), same gap for bath.
heat: Take differences of independent operator expectations in system and bath; do not author reference using producer population-update or heat formula.
oracle: Construct rho tensor diag(1-nu,nu); apply excitation-preserving 4x4 rotation in |01>,|10> with cosine sqrt(1-gamma), sine sqrt(gamma); partial-trace bath; apply explicit probabilistic I/Z dephasing; numpy.linalg.eigvalsh for passive rearrangement and entropy.
physicalCaveat: Third case is deliberately a population-inverted resource, not a passive positive-temperature reservoir.
scope: Optional independent three-case numerical cross-check of energy agent thermalQubitWork
timing: Frozen after learning public API conventions only; before reading producer implementation, outputs or checker.

tolerances.comparisonMethod: Normalize all energies by the independently constructed h*f before comparison; no absolute joule tolerance hiding errors.
